component.name: TangoQ
component.summary: Argentine tango DJ software based on Mixxx

description.p: TangoQ is DJ software for Argentine tango events. It keeps Mixxx's familiar deck and library workflow while focusing on tandas, cortinas, set timing, and safe operation during a live milonga.

ul.li: Ordered tanda queues with Tango, Vals, Milonga, and Alt/Nuevo groups
Dedicated cortina timing and fade controls
Set timing, transition countdowns, and tanda progress
Live-mode safeguards against disruptive queue and deck actions
Start and audible-range waveform markers for precise handoffs
Database-powered music library and broad controller support
